title: Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky
abstract: arXiv:2610.00647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental

translated_title: 群不变统计量决定嵌入几何：从巴赫到夜空的表示之调和分析
translated_abstract: 语言模型为月份、星期、地点等概念学习到的表示呈现出一致的几何结构：圆形和马鞍形的“薯片状”流形。近期研究将这些结构追溯到词共现统计中的平移对称性，并在共现仅依赖于概念所构成的阿贝尔格上距离时，推导出了所观察到的傅里叶几何。我们证明，更一般的对称性概念同样能给出具有结构的预测。考虑由任意有限群、紧群和齐性空间所定义的对称性，我们证明：只要某个词族的共现统计在群 G 下保持不变，学习到的词嵌入就由 G 的不可约表示的矩阵元素构成。当 G 为循环群时，便会出现圆形和薯片状结构，此时不可约表示正是傅里叶模。我们在三个实验中验证了这种不可约表示结构……
tldr: 该论文将语言模型嵌入几何的对称性理论从阿贝尔群的平移对称推广到任意群，证明只要词共现统计在群 G 下不变，学到的词嵌入就必然由 G 的不可约表示的矩阵元素构成，从而统一解释了圆形和“薯片状”等流形结构的来源。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes the symmetry theory of embedding geometry from abelian translation symmetry to arbitrary groups, proving that whenever word co-occurrence statistics are invariant under a group G, the learned embeddings consist of matrix elements of G's irreducible representations—thereby unifying the explanation of circular and "Pringle"-shaped manifold structures.
